build_loss_matrix_singleton: build a loss matrix that discourages overlap with a single class using loss_matrix_singleton_zero
build_loss_matrix_confusion: build a loss matrix to penalize confusion between two classes using loss_matrix_confusion
build_loss_matrix_group: build a loss matrix that discourages confidence sets of group 0 to contain group 1 classes
build_size_weights_group: build class size weights for multiple groups of classes using size_weights_group
build_loss_matrix_importance: build a diagonal loss matrix with custom per-class weights using loss_matrix_importance
